units.source_text: 这樱树周围铺着粗粗的白沙，沙地右首是一片松林，

en.t: Coarse white sand was spread around this cherry tree, and to the right of the sandy ground there was a grove of pines,

units.source_text: 在这庭园里可算是挺拔的了，显得格外美。

en.t: which could be considered quite tall and graceful in this garden, making it look especially beautiful.

units.source_text: 然后，他们来到了神苑的出口。

en.t: Then they came to the exit of the shrine garden.
